g.text: Symptom: Payment service returned HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors to the API Gateway.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 2. Why did the payment service time out?

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Intermediate Cause: Its PostgreSQL database connection pool was 100% exhausted with all threads waiting.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 3. Why was the database connection pool exhausted?

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Component Failure: In-flight SQL queries were blocked waiting on exclusive row and table locks.

g.text: Trigger Event: An unindexed, multi-table heavy analytics batch report was initiated during peak checkout traffic.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: 5. Why did batch analytics run against production master during peak?

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Latent Architectural Vulnerability: Reporting tool lacked read-replica connection strings, query timeout guardrails,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: and architectural network isolation from the transactional OLTP cluster!
